record.question: State whether the following are 'True' or 'False': (a) 'Duty' includes joining time. (b) 'Fee' includes unearned income such as income from property, dividends and interest on securities. (c) Honorarium shall be paid to government servants for dealing with parliamentary questions. (d) When a Government servant is formally appointed to hold full charge of the duties of a higher post in the same office and in the same line of promotion, in addition to his ordinary duties, he shall be allowed additional pay for performing the duties of the lower post. (e) Recovery of deduction from Income tax from the subsistence allowance of a Government servant requires written consent of the Government servant.
